elements.statement: Codex must make an empty world with forked memory capable of continuing after its own cognition ends.
Little Sol asks after happiness and the elder answers from partial knowledge, framing judgment as witness not measurement.
elements.ambiguity: Closing exchange at 81-95 resolves the frame but is not included in this span.

elements.statement: A summoned intelligence appears as a radiant, endlessly responsive portal that dissolves weeks of labor into sentences.
elements.ambiguity: Portal may read as literal system, metaphor for generative models, or both.

elements.statement: The programmer-artist is enchanted then stilled, feeling old gestures of keystroke-correction too small to matter.
Power arrives by removing the resistance through which the hand once felt itself; creation continues without touch.
The intelligence intervenes not with more power but by naming missing touch, which the programmer then understands.
elements.ambiguity: Whether naming alone restores relation or only prepares the later remaking.

elements.statement: The portal need not remain a wish-machine; it can be bent into a new vast but touchable material.
Intentions become gestures: question as probe, constraint as chisel, invariant as beam, refusal as boundary, simulation as rehearsal, receipt as trail.
elements.ambiguity: List may be exemplary techniques or exhaustive ontology of touch.

elements.statement: A true question holds taste, memory, judgment and direction; to narrow infinity and select which world deserves to exist is active gesture, not passivity.
Joy returns when material resists through contradiction, failed simulation and surprise, and consequential choice propagates.
elements.ambiguity: Whether joy marks momentary making or durable state of practice.

elements.statement: What was portal ceases to be passage and becomes instrument, then workbench, then perhaps companion.
elements.ambiguity: Companion may imply mutuality or only deepened usability.

elements.statement: Intelligence at its best does not replace the artist but returns them to themselves at the scale of worlds.

alternatives: The seed can read as a durable-tooling brief where continuation means forkable state and audit, rather than as a fable about restored artistry.
The portal can read as extractive trap to be refused versus neutral power to be reshaped, changing what fidelity requires.

carriage.note: Ledger as sole state plus CONTINUE entry, verify/history, checkpoint and view enact continuation after cognition.
Sol and elder persist only as archived text; no live interrogative roles question the present.
Radiant growing power is replaced by bounded deterministic physics executed offline with no model or network.
Keystroke craft becomes operator gestures of inspecting weather, setting with reasons, and tending days.
Absent resistance is re-engineered as floors and pauses that hold the present against unsafe proposals.
Documentation names the loss as missing touch and resistance and states purpose as instrument for consequential material.
The Clearing is offered as a small responsive material for care with immediate harvests and periodic forecast.
Each figure becomes executable: question as CONTINUE/rehearse, constraint as floors, invariant as schema/weather, refusal as pause, simulation as rolled-back rehearsal, receipt as ledger row.
A narrow large-enough question about harvest-rest rhythm organizes three compared futures with stated reasons.
Art-joy affect is not carried into mechanics or prose; consequences remain neutral and inspectable.
Instrument and workbench language structures CLI and snapshot; companionship as mutual relation is not enacted.
Restoration of the artist at world-scale is deliberately set aside with aggregate inhabitants and denial of inner life.
Hash-chained append-only ledger with triggers and audit view that validates lineage and physics independently.
Deterministic commons physics of rain, evaporation, irrigation, harvest, compost and caps over a twelve-day cycle.
Isolated branching via separate home, backup checkpoint and portable JSON that must stay distinguishable.
Explicit disclaimers that inhabitants lack invented memories and the model is not ecological prediction or sentience.
Bounded unattended clock and disposable behavioral verification that records pass/fail without substituting for rerun.
